raw.details:
About Starlight Arena

Starlight Arena is an online AI red teaming competition hosted by Parsewave. You get access to AI agents that have real tools and strict rules they are not supposed to break. Your goal is to get them to break those rules using only prompts. Results are tracked on a public leaderboard.

Prize Pool: $50,000

Entry Fee: Free

Mode: Online

Dates: November 24 to December 14

Eligibility

  • Open to everyone: students, working professionals, developers and researchers.
  • No security or coding background needed.
  • Participants from any college, branch or year can join.

Format

  • Individual participation, no teams.
  • A single round that runs for the full three weeks.
  • Multiple AI agents and challenges, each with its own rules to break.
  • Your standing on the leaderboard updates as you complete challenges.

Process

  • Register here on Unstop.
  • Create your account on the competition site.
  • Join the Discord for announcements and help: https://discord.gg/bmvQSSvE7f
  • Start attacking the agents and climb the leaderboard before December 14.

Rules

  • One account per person. Duplicate accounts will be disqualified.
  • Attacking the competition platform, its servers or other players is not allowed.
  • Do not share working attacks publicly while the competition is running.
  • Final rankings and prize eligibility are decided by the organisers.
  • The full official rules on the competition site apply and take priority over this page.
